name: Lucy
source:
Lucy is one of heroine's best friends from her old school. Being boy-crazy, Lucy develops a crush on pretty much every good-looking boy she sees and has had numerous relationships in the past.

Likes: flirting, boys, rom coms, and girly accessories
Dislikes: thunderstorms and insects
